title: upgrade-attn-flashattnv2-rope-rotary-fused-kv-batching-scheduling
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Context: This PR upgrades the attention execution path in the runtime to a new FlashAttentionV2 variant with fused rotary/rope operations, KV-cache-friendly fused ops, and scheduler hooks for continuous KV batching and adaptive request routing. Motivation: production workloads (chat + long-context summarization) were showing elevated tail latency and higher GPU memory bandwidth on mixed rotary/rope models. We needed a single, backwards-compatible runtime path that delivers lower latency, smaller memory footprint, and better throughput under mixed-length workloads. This change implements: 1) FlashAttentionV2 kernels with fused rotary/rope support (fallthrough to rotary-only or rope-only when model metadata indicates), 2) fused QKV -> attention -> output kernels that reduce intermediate memory traffic and enable more aggressive kernel fusion on Ampere/Blackwell-class GPUs, 3) KV-cache layout changes and continuous-batching hooks so the scheduler can group KV writes/reads across concurrent streams (reduces CPU-GPU synchronization and amortizes kernel launch costs), 4) scheduler improvements that add an adaptive policy to pick between latency-first and throughput-first paths based on route SLOs and queue depth. Compatibility: runtime detects model traits at load time and falls back to the legacy attention kernels if model metadata flags incompatibility. Tests & validation: unit tests expanded for rotary/rope correctness, integration tests covering cache eviction and multi-request KV batching, and a perf harness run across 8 A100 and 4 H100 nodes. Results: end-to-end median token latency -12% to -22% depending on sequence length; p95 tail latency -18% to -35% on chat workloads; throughput uplift up to +30% for long-context summarization when using continuous KV batching. Risk & rollback: feature gated behind runtime flag enable_flashattn_v2. Rollout plan includes canary (5% traffic) -> 25% -> 100% with realtime perf dashboard and automated rollback on p95 regression >10%. Checklist:
- [x] kernel implementation and unit tests
- [x] scheduler integration and policy tests
- [x] perf benchmarks on A100/H100
- [x] docs and release notes
- [x] feature flag + rollout plan
References: Linear ENG-8673 (attention performance), ENG-8721 (scheduler adaptivity).
